I approached the altar in the vast, elaborately decorated tomb. This holy place was thought lost for millennia, and I was surely the first to step foot in it since the prophet was laid to rest and his followers left it, as the legend told. They told me I was crazy to believe the legends of old, that I would die finding nothing on my perilous journey. Yet here I stood, about to complete a journey I have dedicated decades of my life to.

The altar looked exactly as legend said it would. Four sides of pure gold panels, molded into a story of how the universe came to be. Sunk into the top of the altar was a basin where the sacrificial blood was to be placed. While I still shudder at the evil I committed to attain the blood, I'm sure that the incredible miracle I am soon to witness will make the nightmares I've had since worth it.

I still can't believe the process is so simple from here. Just place the blood in the basin and speak with God. It seems too simple, and yet everything within the legend has proven true so far. The basin is much smaller than I had anticipated and I'm left with more blood than I needed to fill it. The thought that I could have stopped the barbaric collection ritual I performed so much earlier than I did fills me with a sickness more powerful than the one I had during the ritual itself. So much suffering, such a waste. But it is no matter now, I must focus and summon God.

As my hands begin to tremble and my legs nearly give way I call out "Oh Lord! I humbly beg to speak with one of your children! I have endured much to reach this place, I hope to ask you but one question!"

Suddenly an energetic presence appears before me. It is shapeless yet I can see its form. It seems to not exist, though I can see it as clearly as I could my reflection in a mirror. Is this energy that whom I seek or have I simply gone mad after all these years.

"Sup?"

That voice! I know I don't hear it with my ears as the tomb is vast yet there is no echo. I am hearing the message inside my head! This must be God after all! I'm not sure what to expect and can barely comprehend what is in front of me. Meekly, the only words I can form are, "Are you...God?"

"Yeah, I guess."

"Oh Lord, thank you for speaking with me. I am amazed you are here to say the least and honored that you would grace me with your presence."

"No problem, I had dick-all else to do. This place is fancy as hell, what is it?"

I'm surprised that the creator of all things would need to be told any kind of information, but am delighted to share this grand example of mankind's devotion to our creator. "We are in a grand temple built in your honor, and are currently in the tomb of the prophet you sent us long ago."

"Proph...oh shit, this is one of these kind of things again. Look, I don't mean to sound unappreciative, but whoever you have in here is no prophet of mine. I haven't paid attention to this place for a long time."

I'm nearly struck down by what I just heard. "If this is not your prophet, why did you heed my call?"

"Meh, just good timing. I had actually forgot this world existed and I figured it was worth taking a look. That and you said you only wanted to ask me one thing so I knew it'd be a short trip. You all have done some neat things with this place. You're killing it though, but hey you do you."

Forgot our world existed? I don't understand how that is possible. I want to ask but I can't get my mouth to move at all. Beyond blankly gawking at this essence I'm paralyzed.

"Yeah, sorry about that. I know it's probably a lot to take in, but to be fair whatever role you thought I had here is one you made up. It's the whole reason I don't usually bounce around worlds much, I didn't want to get anyone's hopes up. Look, I know this shatters your worldview and all, but I didn't think I was going to be here long and honestly the more I'm looking around the more I'm realizing the neat things you've done are actually just impressive to look at but shitty once you inspect them, so I want to bail. If you could pull yourself together for a second and ask your question..."

My mind races. Not only does our creator not seem to care about us but he is also displeased with all we've accomplished! All will be well though, once I find out the wisdom it can impart, I can surely change the world for the better. We will be more on our destined course for sure! "Of course, my Lord. My question is only this: What is the meaning of life?"

The essence remains silent for a short period, likely contemplating how to explain such an important concept to a mind as feeble as mine. The beauty before me swirls before replying. "...What?"

Confusion? How is the creator of all thing confused? Perhaps I am to blame for the simplicity of my question. "On this planet, why did you create life and what purpose do we serve? What was your goal for humanity?"

"Wow, you're going to be bummed. Dude, like I said, I forgot about you guys. The last time I was here I thought it was a neat enough little place to started messing with some of the molecules that had collected. This was like the third planet I found that was stable enough for me to mess around with. When you create a universe it turns out that most of it is just random balls of junk. It takes a while to find one you can use. Most of the time I'm just looking at the stuff that happened to form; all I did was bring matter into this plane of existence. It did some really neat stuff this time around. Your atomic generators explode, do you know how cool that is to watch? In the last one of these I created they just kinda burnt out. This shit is way cooler."

"But...life..." This is all my body was capable producing.

"Like I said I was messing around with some of the molecules and formed some little things that could move on their own. It's kinda tricky figuring out how that works in each plane. Anyway, after I made a couple of them I set them out to see if they would do anything. Not much happened for a while, then I saw one of the atomic generators nearby about to explode so I went to watch that and kinda just figured I messed this one up. Found some better worlds a little later and ended up getting better at making new things, so just kinda stuck around those places. I'm actually amazed anything became of this place."

"So, you didn't make humans!?"

"Naw, though I like the name you gave yourself. The language you use here is kinda weird and I don't know why you use so many different types, but it's simple and that name is neat."

"Th...Then why are we here!?!"

"Dumb luck? I mean you're way more complex than the things I made before I left. As I'm looking around it's kinda impressive those little things turned into so many different kinds of creatures. But again, I didn't make you. I just made the precursor to you I guess. This was all cool to see, but I can feel your emotions and this is starting to suck so I'm going to leave. I'll do you a solid as I leave and stop that big rock heading your way from hitting your world since, ya know, kinda left you hanging with everything else. Good luck with the rest of your existence, I hope your world doesn't fuck you over as hard as it seems like it's about to. Treat it better if you can. See ya."

The essence has vanished. I stand alone, in a tomb of an artificially important figure, knowing that my life was not only an accident, but that I spent nearly all of it trying to figure that out. I have no purpose anymore, no reason to continue on. I've never felt this empty before.

Assuming you mean "man made" or "man accelerated" then the fasted thing in the world would likely be the hadrons in the Large Hadron Collider. They reach can reach 6.5 TeV (or ~99.9999991% the speed of light). It is possible there is a faster electron beam accelerator out there as electrons are ~1800 lighter than hadrons and thus require much less energy to accelerate. For example the SPring-8 Synchrotron in Japan accelerates electrons to 8GeV (or ~99.999999% the speed of light). There may be a more powerful electron beam accelerator out there.

If you don't count atomic particles then the next fastest thing is probably voyager 1 space probe currently traveling at roughly 17.3 km/s after several gravity assists.

If you only want to consider passenger carrying things that would probably be the Apollo capsule which reached a top velocity of 11.2 km/s.

Ignoring space, the X-15 reached about 2 km/s. The SR-71 reaches around 1.1+ km/s.

At sea level, non-passenger carrying, the fastest thing is probably the projectile from the US Navy rail gun at ~2.5km/s.
